notes: Inspiré d'un contenu du label weird_alpha qui a marché chez nous (@mentoridaily, 0fbd8952). full test BLEO : accroche jamais faite (format « things you only learn after X »). cta B. Slide Sophia en position 5.

slides.texte_overlay:
things you only learn after
spending time alone

your own taste

without other people's opinions around, you find out what music, food and places you truly love. many people discover they've been quietly living someone else's taste.

how loud your thoughts are

silence shows you the stories your mind tells all day. once you can hear them clearly, you can finally choose which ones truly deserve your attention.

that you're good company

the first quiet evenings feel strange, then slowly they feel like a treat. learning to enjoy your own company is one of the most freeing things there is.

how curious you are

alone time shows you what you really want to learn about, from stars to old myths. feeding that curiosity a little each day makes solitude feel warm and rich.
slides.texte_sophia:
how curious you are

alone time showed me how curious i am. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, a star or a myth, and those 5 minutes make my quiet evenings feel so rich.

slides.texte_overlay:
who really matters

when you step back from constant plans, you notice who checks on you and who you miss. solitude quietly shows you which people truly belong in your life.
